title: Application tracker (campaign/applications.json)
description: Each job the person has applied for or is weighing up, its stage, and when the last step happened. Stages use career-ops' ten names so the two tools can talk. Every stage change is one the person confirmed, and each is also appended to campaign/applications-log.tsv, which is never edited. Progress only: score.py never reads this file. scripts/applications.py writes both files.

extension.description: Extension field: any key starting x_ holds data the engine never reads. Kept as is.

stage.description: career-ops' stage names. evaluated: looked at, not applied. applied: sent. responded: the employer replied. assessment: a test or take-home. interview: an interview happened (last_step_on is its date). offer, rejected, hired: the outcome. discarded: the person stopped. skip: decided not to apply.

org.description: A target id from config.json, or another organisation's short name.

role_id.description: The role in market/roles/latest.json, when it is one.

last_step_on.description: The date of the last real step (a stage change or a follow-up sent).

nudges.description: Follow-ups sent since the last stage change; at most 2.

thanked.description: A thank-you note was sent after the latest interview.

predicted.description: LVLme's odds for this role on the day it was sent: the latest scored run on or before applied_on. Written once when the application is recorded as sent; read only by the 'How right has LVLme been' panel (scripts/_calibration.py), never by score.py.

warm.description: A warm referral (D3 at least 4) on that day.
